verdict.rationale: Runloop documents devbox tunnels that securely expose devbox ports over a simple URL (docs-5, docs-33). A tutorial shows starting an app and sharing a live preview link in pull requests via tunnels (docs-54). Tunnels are also listed among the SDK capabilities (docs-29). Missing for 10: detail on whether URLs are publicly accessible versus authenticated, port and protocol configuration specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
